dish: Rigatoni a la vodka with prosciutto and peas; wine slushies and the family bakery's cakes
w: Hybrid winery-eatery opened in 2018 by baker-winemaker Michael Angelo Ciocca and his brother Matt, with a big, lively patio. Named in Cleveland Magazine's Northeast Ohio's Best Wineries and voted the region's top winery in its 2026 readers' poll; on the Beacon Journal's 2025 Greater Akron outdoor-dining list and WKYC's NE Ohio wineries feature.

dish: House pilsners to chocolate-coffee ale with pulled-pork sliders, Metropolis popcorn and meat-and-cheese boards
w: Cuyahoga Falls' first brewery (2017), in a 1920s car dealership on Front Street with a taproom over the Cuyahoga. In Cleveland Magazine's beer guide and '12 Must-Go Places in Cuyahoga Falls', and voted Best Cuyahoga Falls Hot Spot by Akron Life readers.

dish: Pretzel-crusted trout with caper butter; seared sea scallops with roasted corn and smoked tomato
w: Chef Brandt Evans' ridge-top restaurant built like a national-park lodge, with views over miles of woodland. Reviewed by Cleveland Magazine ('Red-hot and Blue') and Cleveland Scene; its rock-waterfall patio is on the Beacon Journal's 2025 Greater Akron outdoor-dining list.

dish: Wood-fired pizzas from a year-round outdoor oven with the Loose Caboose Belgian wheat and Happy Daze hazy IPA
w: National-park-inspired family brewery (2023) — the founders wanted Peninsula, but water logistics brought them to Hudson, five miles from Lock 29 and the Ledges. Profiled by Ohio Magazine and Akron Life ('Fresh Brewed').

dish: Salt-and-pepper Texas brisket (up to 40 a day), pulled pork and bourbon banana pudding
w: Austin-trained Joe Menendez's roadside smoker at Route 43 and Tallmadge Road in Brimfield, open Friday-Sunday until it sells out (600-800 lb a day). Cleveland Scene (Douglas Trattner) calls it some of the best barbecue in the region; in Cleveland Magazine's best-bites coverage and the Beacon Journal.

dish: The DaVinci Italian sub on a baguette and the Frenchy burger (portabella, caramelized onion, Gruyère sauce)
w: Highland Square neighborhood bar-restaurant around a horseshoe bar, its walls a museum of T-shirts from Akron landmarks and businesses; founder Frank Horvath retired after 30 years and the new owners kept the traditions. Signal Akron Best of the City 2026 Best Burger winner (the West Market Classic on a Massoli's bun) and a Beacon Journal Local Flavor pick.

dish: Signature chocolate-covered strawberries, homemade fudge and clusters
w: Family chocolatier in an 1898 building on Hartville's main street since 1986 (Bob Barton and his parents), which also makes molds for home chocolatiers and runs booked Cocoa Concepts tours. First place for Best Chocolate in Akron Life's 330 Flavor Awards; featured in Ohio Magazine's Best Hometowns profile of Hartville.

dish: Boneless short ribs in veal demi-glace with bacon Bistro mac and cheese; fried green tomatoes with chipotle aioli
w: Upscale-casual Plain Township bistro (2014) with house-made desserts. The Canton Repository's review says it 'shines' and it's on the Repository's Stark County patio round-up; listed by Visit Canton.

dish: The Joey Burger (10 oz, mushrooms, onions, Swiss and provolone) and the fried whitefish hoagie
w: Massillon's oldest gathering place — a stagecoach stop turned tavern, serving since 1891. The Canton Repository's review calls it 'a little Stark County gem'; listed in Visit Canton's Massillon dining.
